coinbase_agentic_market.launch_action: after the exact Geomacro resource is observed in Bazaar, verify any downstream Agentic Market visibility and metadata independently; do not infer listing from payment success alone

circle_agent_marketplace.launch_action: after the dedicated Circle production 402 route is explicitly activated, run seller readiness, submit the service, then verify visibility through Circle Discovery API

x402_new.launch_action: verify post-launch canonical x402 metadata and Bazaar activity propagate to the directory

agent402_tools.launch_action: register geomacro.live only after an approved production endpoint returns a valid 402; verify crawler sees OpenAPI and canonical x402 JSON discovery without testnet leakage

payapi_market.launch_action: list one durable production path after launch and allow PayAPI settlement verification; verify delivered product and receiver match the Geomacro ledger

x402scan.launch_action: run origin discovery against geomacro.live, review detected routes, register only approved production endpoints

x402_list.launch_action: submit the canonical service URL and approved endpoint paths only after they return valid production 402 challenges

nevermined_registry.launch_action: complete sandbox acceptance evidence, configure an approved live plan at launch, then publish the provider listing after the global launch gate is authorized

true402.launch_action: submit an approved Base-mainnet USDC resource only after live 402 and smoke settlement validation

402bazaar.launch_action: consider only after primary free or official discovery surfaces are verified and current directory terms are rechecked

goat_mainnet.launch_action: apply through the current GOAT Flow merchant portal, wait for approval, configure receiving token and address from live Mainnet capabilities, then publish a bounded product or paid API route under the coordinated launch gate

pay_sh_pay_skills.deferred_reason: Current provider publication is Solana-mainnet-specific. Geomacro will not add a new payment rail solely for directory coverage without separate product justification.

submission_identity.short_description: Machine-readable geopolitical and macro risk intelligence for country, directional-corridor and financial-agent pre-flight decisions.
submission_identity.long_description: Geomacro provides source-governed geopolitical and macro risk intelligence to software and AI agents. Requests are checked for current deliverability, freshness and commercial source eligibility before payment is requested. Paid delivery can include structured risk context, signed Risk Objects and non-executing Risk Gate decision context. Geomacro does not custody funds, sign customer transactions or replace sanctions screening, legal advice or counterparty due diligence.
